The '''scurrier''' was a [[Rodent/Legends|rodent]] native to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and was considered a pest by the locals of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] and [[Mos Gamos]]. Scurriers had horns on their heads. Those of a male were thick and curved, while those of a female were thin and straight.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Scurrier.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A female scurrier.]]

Named for their swift gait and skittish temperament,<ref name=":0">{{DB|creature|scurrier|scurrier}}</ref> scurriers were small omnivores with an appetite for garbage. They would scavenge in trash heaps in search of food and material for their nests. They were known to find their way aboard docked freighters and transports, thus propagating the scurrier population across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]; they were even found on stations like [[Outland Transit Station]]. Worse, scurriers had a penchant for picking apart machinery, a trait that was hardly welcome on a cargo- or passenger-filled transport.

Apart from this dangerous habit, scurriers posed only a marginal threat to sentients. Though they would fiercely defend their territory, scurriers usually fled at the first sign of danger (say, a passing [[X-34 landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]]),<ref name="IV" /> able only to call upon a high-pitched squeak and a painful bite<ref name=":0" /> to use against advancing predators like [[Anooba/Legends|anoobas]] and [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rats]].<ref name="WSW" /> Their bite sometimes carried a disease known as the [[scurrier disease]].<ref name="Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]''</ref> In spite of this, [[scurrier tips]] were a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] delicacy, referred to as "scuzzi spits" in [[Huttese/Legends|their language]].<ref name="Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide real-life book">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref>

Scurriers traveled in packs of around thirty, and were often found hanging out with [[Jakrab/Legends|jakrabs]] and known to appropriate burrows of abandoned [[Profogg/Legends|profogg]] towns. Occasionally, they would steal from food storage chambers in unabandoned profogg-occupied profogg towns, intent on taking the profoggs' collected underground [[molo seed]]s.<ref name="WSW">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>{{Talesstart}}Scurriers were mentioned in the expression "you're looking like something the scurrier dragged in". In 9 BBY [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Annie]] used the expression to describe [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who was suffering from a case of [[dust fever]].<ref name="Sandstorm comic story">{{Tales|15|Sandstorm (comic story)}}</ref>{{Talesend}}
==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|What was that? Guess it was a scurrier.|Stormtrooper|<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref>}}
The scurrier was a new creation for the [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|''Star Wars'' Special Edition]].<ref>[[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|''The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition'']]</ref> The scurrier design was refined through sketches by [[TyRuben Ellingson]]. The computer-generated models of the scurrier were heavily modified models loosely based on [[Wikipedia:Velociraptor|velociraptor]] studies developed for [[Wikipedia:Jurassic Park|''Jurassic Park'']].<ref name=":0" />

In ''[[LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy]]'' and ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]'', scurriers are mistakenly called [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rats]].<ref name="LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy">''[[LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy]]''</ref><ref name="LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]''</ref>

In ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]'', when you approach a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] who doesn't immediately see you, he might rationalize Kyle's sounds as a scurrier.<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref>
